title: Leta NDE 3923
content: I woke up at 4:00 am. I went into the bathroom. I started to feel queasy. I felt faint. The next thing I remember was I was FLYING, super-fast, head first down a long, dark hallway. It was very dark. There was someone on my right holding my arm taking me. I could tell that this person KNEW where we were going and it was their mission to bring me. I was screaming no, no, no. I did not want to go. I could see objects going by me on each side. I don't know what they were because we were flying so fast. It felt like we were going down that dark hallway for a long time. I remember just thinking no, where am I? Where are we going? Then we stopped in front of a door on the left. I don't know what color the door was, all I knew was it was a door and I was not going through it! I kept saying NO! The next thing I remember was my husband telling me I had a seizure. It took me about half an hour to finally figure out what happened, where I was, and who my husband was. He said I had stopped breathing and I was turning grey. He tipped my head back and got me breathing, and then I started to have the seizure.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain woke up at 4:00 am. Was fine during that whole day Other 'Had a seizure, stopped breathing.' I passed out, stopped breathing, was given CPR and began to have a seizure.

elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: The whole experience felt equally heightened.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I did not know where I was and everything was happening very fast.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: Everything was moving so fast it was hard to focus.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: When I was talking it sounded like it wasn't coming from me.

elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain I could feel someone on my right taking me down the hallway, but I didn't try to look at them. I could just feel them there.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I was very scared and did not know where I was going and who the 'person' was that was taking me.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Yes I came to a door on the left. I did not want to go through that door. I was terrified of the unknown. I did not want that door to open.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes Now I KNOW there is more out there when we die.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Now I KNOW there is more out there when we die.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin

elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Immediately after. I told the person who did CPR. I do not remember telling him, but later, when I told him about it he said, you already told me that whole story when you came to. He said, 'Wow, really!' Other people don't say much about it - just, 'Wow.'
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real It was real. It did happen; it WAS NOT a 'dream'. It happened years ago and I still remember it vividly.
